elements.requirement: An individual guilty of an offence under section 1, 2 or 6 is liable on summary conviction to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months, to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum, or to both.
elements.quote: An individual guilty of an offence under section 1, 2 or 6 is liable— (a) on summary conviction, to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months, or to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum, or to both

elements.requirement: An individual guilty of an offence under section 1, 2 or 6 is liable on conviction on indictment to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 10 years, to a fine, or to both.
elements.quote: on conviction on indictment, to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 10 years, or to a fine, or to both

elements.requirement: In the application of the provision in England and Wales, the reference to 12 months' imprisonment on summary conviction for an individual is to be read as the general limit in a magistrates’ court, or as 6 months if the offence was committed before 2 May 2022.
elements.quote: reference in subsection (1)(a) to 12 months is to be read as a reference to the general limit in a magistrates’ court (or to 6 months in relation to an offence committed before 2 May 2022)

elements.requirement: Any person other than an individual who is guilty of an offence under section 1, 2 or 6 is liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
elements.quote: Any other person guilty of an offence under section 1, 2 or 6 is liable— (a) on summary conviction, to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum

elements.requirement: Any person other than an individual who is guilty of an offence under section 1, 2 or 6 is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine.
elements.quote: (b) on conviction on indictment, to a fine

elements.requirement: A person guilty of an offence under section 7 is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine.
elements.quote: A person guilty of an offence under section 7 is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine.

elements.requirement: In the application of the provision to Northern Ireland, the reference to 12 months' imprisonment on summary conviction for an individual is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
elements.quote: in its application to Northern Ireland, as a reference to 6 months
